title: Private linguistic and record comparison checks
question: Do the private annotation and strict record comparison boundaries preserve declared reading, source coordinates and empty/invalid accounting?
method: Run independently authored positive/negative fixtures for annotations, sentence preservation, strict five-family records and prior semantic alignment; inspect with scoped Ruff/Pyrefly and independent review.
conclusion: 75 focused tests and scoped Ruff/Pyrefly passed. Independent reviewer closed display metadata loss and found no material private scorer issue. No protected reference isolation, admitted prediction binding, actual accuracy or full M1-13 qualification.
